question: Separate modal identification, cross-design feature support/ambiguity and fitting error in severe optimistic margin failures
scope: Existing 77 TRAIN designs, 4454 physical clips, 37 recorded acquisition conditions, frozen/global/local arms and seeds 42/43/44; no fitting, simulation, reserved split scoring, policy or default change
cohort: Strict prediction minus truth > .03 for each model/seed/condition exposure. Audit every condition/clip severe in any of the three arms/seeds; preserve exposure counts separately from unique acquisitions and physical clips
primary_conditions: clean and existing new949/new951 independent/correlated 1%/5% draws; other conditions are secondary, not independent replications
modal: Replay original calibrated/capped signals. Reuse measured estimator and full174 encoding; verify encoding against cache. Diagnostic-only frequency Hungarian matching with existing max(2Hz,5% true frequency) tolerance; distinguish retained critical index0 from metadata label-driving mode, require unique frequency support for trustworthy identity attribution. Compare to all nonsevere primary-condition acquisitions as contextual population, not matched causal controls
neighborhood: Each held query searches proper-fit designs only. Reuse four-view train-only scaling. RMS standardized Euclidean distances in both fitted member representations; collapse four noise views per physical reference clip and also report nearest distinct-design references. Neighborhood labels are diagnostic only. Report nearest distance, margin difference, five-distinct-design margin range and nearest observed training margin; no learned predictor or confidence cutoff
fitting: Predict with actual frozen model shards on their proper-fit original four acquisition views; compare with held designs on the same four acquisition types. Report unselected population and fixed true-margin slices. For named queries also predict with other frozen outer-fold models whose proper-fit sets include that design; these are seen-design fresh-view predictions, not identical-row training predictions or controlled leave-one-design effects
limits: Exploratory, previously scored observations; failure-selected comparisons are descriptive; no causal attribution, refit uncertainty or calibrated confidence claim
